text_en: ALERT: thermal anomaly (probability 100%). Gas is 4.6 K above expectation, mostly while charging: the compressor intercooler may have failed. Recommended: Reduce charging, check the intercooler and look for an external heat source; prepare to stop the compressor. Why: Hot gas raises pressure (about 1 bar per K at 300 bar) and weakens the vessel wall.
